content.title: 'American Idol' 2026: Who made the top 11? Who got eliminated?
content.text: Lottie covers entertainment for the Deseret News, with a focus on reality competition shows, music and "Jeopardy!"Your browser does not support the audio element.The 14 singers remaining on “American Idol” this season likely entered Monday night’s live episode with more nerves than usual. After an unexpected delay last week — when “Idol” announced it was too hard to determine in real time which two singers had been eliminated based on viewers’ votes — the singers finally learned the results. At the start of Monday’s episode, “Idol” revealed that singers Julián Kalel and Jake Thistle didn’t receive enough votes to advance to the top 12 round of the competition. But that wasn’t the only elimination of the episode. The top 12 contestants then performed 1990s’ hits — selected by “Idol” judges Carrie Underwood, Lionel Richie and Luke Bryan — for a shot at the top 11. Here’s a look at the performances from the top 12 round — and who got eliminated.‘American Idol’ top 12 performancesBelow are the contestants’ performances during the top 12 round:Braden Rumfelt — ‘All By Myself,’ Céline DionBrooks Rosser — ‘Linger,’ The CranberriesChris Tungseth — ‘I’ll Be,’ Edwin McCain Daniel Stallworth — ‘It Ain’t Over ‘Til It’s Over,’ Lenny KravitzHannah Harper – ‘Heads Carolina, Tails California,’ Jo Dee MessinaJordan McCullough — ‘Always Be My Baby,’ Mariah CareyJesse Findling — ‘Wonderwall,’ OasisKeyla Richardson — ‘Zombie,’ The CranberriesKyndal Inskeep— ‘Iris,’ Goo Goo DollsLucas Leon — ‘It’s Your Love,’ Tim McGrawPhilmon Lee — ‘Hard to Handle,’ The Black CrowesRae — ‘Love Will Lead You Back,’ Taylor DayneWho made the ‘American Idol’ top 11? At the end of the episode, “Idol” revealed that singers Rae and Jesse Findling were in the bottom two. With the decision in the judges’ hands, the save went to Rae and Findling got sent home. Below are the singers in the “American Idol” top 11: Braden RumfeltBrooks RosserChris TungsethDaniel StallworthHannah HarperJordan McCulloughKeyla RichardsonKyndal InskeepLucas LeonPhilmon LeeRaeWhat happens next on ‘American Idol’? During the next round of “American Idol,” which airs Monday, April 13, the top 11 will perform hits from Rock & Roll Hall of Fame inductees. The inductees for the Rock & Roll Hall of Fame 2026 class will be revealed during the two-hour episode, according to the TV listing.
